decisions.reason: The semi-hard cheese wheel sits close to the firm's established cheese offer and was promoted to its own page in 2019, which suggests it met aspirations in a growing organic market and gives management no shortfall that would trigger search for alternatives.

The spicy cheese survived the 2019 pruning that removed the weaker launches and got its own product page, so it appears to perform satisfactorily, though as a flavoured variant it carries somewhat more risk than the core cheeses.

The mild creamy soft cheese was highlighted at launch and given its own page in 2019, whereas the washed-rind soft cheese was removed, which indicates it met the aspiration level and is worth keeping in a narrow, focused range.
